status: Exact decomposition and conditional drive/cancellation examples; no representation or noise law selected
value_lineage: C-14/H-75 gives individual contextual paths within a fixed semantic component; C-26/P-60 requires useful historical influence and C-18/H-77 preserves within-polarity ratios during cancellation. C-17 noise support must be assessed against those same values.

analytical_coordinates.equation: For a nonzero post-cancellation coordinate, r_i=A*q_i in its surviving polarity, with A=sum_i r_i>0, q_i>=0 and sum_i q_i=1.
analytical_coordinates.meaning: A and q are analysis coordinates computed from existing rates. They are not two stored fields, an alternative neuron representation, or a token decoder. Coordinate normalization remains a separate choice.
analytical_coordinates.limits: The simplex dimension counts local continuous freedom at fixed aggregate and polarity. It is not a number of reliably distinguishable contexts, stored bits, independent paths or learned memory capacity. Boundaries, numerical precision, graph structure and correlated dynamics restrict use. Composition entropy is not automatically predictive-token diversity; cross-coordinate associations and later responses matter.
analytical_coordinates.zero_and_flip: At zero active total, active composition is undefined and H-77 leaves no surviving active rates in that coordinate. A sign change selects the other population without a cell-index correspondence. Context can remain elsewhere; predictive-state behavior remains open under H-78/H-85.

additive_drive.positive_population: Before new drive, p_i=A*q_i and negative active rates are zero. Add nonnegative z_i to the positive population and nonnegative opposite drive with total Z_minus.
additive_drive.interpretation: Cancellation rescales the provisional positive population uniformly; it preserves that provisional composition, not necessarily the composition before new drive.
additive_drive.matching_totals: If Z_plus=Z_minus, D=A exactly, while the composition can still change. The signed aggregate alone cannot detect that change.
additive_drive.paired_histories: For two equal-A histories receiving identical realized added drive and retaining positive sign, their L1 composition difference is multiplied by A/(A+Z_plus). This holds for arbitrary nonnegative added-drive shape, not just uniform drive.
additive_drive.limits: This isolates one addition/cancellation operation. Recurrent propagation, context-sensitive gain, independent stochastic trials, transfer functions and adaptive noise can alter later outcomes.

uniform_drive_reference.equation: For equal per-cell drive epsilon to both m-cell polarities, q_next=lambda*q+(1-lambda)*uniform, lambda=A/(A+m*epsilon); signed total stays A.
uniform_drive_reference.repetition: With repeated equal drive and no intervening recurrent transformation, q_n-uniform=lambda^n*(q_0-uniform).
uniform_drive_reference.limits: Equal drive is a controlled deterministic addition, not a claim about the distribution of white noise. Neither epsilon nor this repeated operation is the proposed neural model; repetitions do not assign a physical frame duration.

downstream_illustration.explanation: An already available unit-weight edge from source cell0 to another target receives different input despite equal current semantic totals. This is an algebraic illustration, not a trained association.

future_comparisons.alternatives: Noise allocation and strength under the same required activity-support behavior
future_comparisons.observations: Measure preservation or restoration of context-dependent cell composition, later prediction, semantic residual and steerability; total signed value and active fraction are insufficient alone.

future_comparisons.alternatives: Existing recurrent response with and without the specific added-drive intervention
future_comparisons.observations: Separate immediate redistribution from subsequent useful amplification. Prefer observing existing rates and later behavior before introducing any separate context storage.
Assess contextual response differences at comparable current semantic totals; equal scalar reconstruction error can hide different cell-level losses.

scope_limit: Exact algebra and finite rational examples only; no SNN training/simulation, memory-capacity measurement, benchmark, project tests or build.

state_precision_reference.status: Conditional representation example; not a learned context or general format verdict
assumptions: 60 active positive cells, zero negative rates; no cancellation needed for these states
Two histories have all rates3/4 except first two rates3/4±2^-13, with their signs swapped
All other causal state and weights are identical; fixed next readout selects the first source with unit nonnegative weight
IEEE binary16/binary32 nearest-even conversion via Python struct; no underflow or tie in this example
interpretation: Both formats preserve the present signed semantic sum exactly, yet binary16 erases this contextual distinction
Small total state error or zero current semantic error does not alone establish preservation of later relevant behavior
This does not prove trained contexts use such small differences or that binary16 is generally inadequate; distinct cell identities can encode more robustly
If the complete causal state becomes identical, identical subsequent inputs cannot recover which of these histories occurred without other information
state_precision_reference.scope_limit: Exact rational and specified floating conversion only; no SNN training or simulation, project test, build or performance claim

fixed_input_context_retention.status: conditional single-operation real-embedding arithmetic; no neuron simulation or empirical trained-memory result

source.access: Read-only mmap of existing local SSD tensor; no copy, download or modification.

fixed_input_context_retention.source_access: Read-only mmap; sampled rows only; source untouched, no copy or download.

sampling.limits: Uniform token-type sample, not corpus transitions; both directions evaluated; observations share token rows and are not iid.

reference_semantics.normalization: Each token vector is scaled to L1 norm1; incoming vector is further scaled by beta. This is diagnostic scaling, not selected input normalization.
reference_semantics.state: Two histories share signed coordinate totals v but differ by a zero-sum redistribution among the60 cells of each surviving polarity. Incoming drive is held identical across histories. No recurrent step, transfer nonlinearity, clipping, noise, decay, readiness operation or quantization.
reference_semantics.difference_distribution: For the reported aggregate, coordinate L1 history differences are proportional to abs(v_j); this is a conditional pattern family, not measured learned context.
reference_semantics.law: If v_j*w_j>=0, an identical same-sign addition leaves absolute within-population differences unchanged. If signs oppose, the factor is max(0,1-beta*abs(w_j)/abs(v_j)).
reference_semantics.aggregate: R=sum_j abs(v_j)*factor_j, since sum_j abs(v_j)=1. Erased coordinate count uses factor==0. Composition differences normalized by new total behave differently from these absolute cell-rate differences.

reciprocal_strength_check.identity: R(v,beta*w)=1-beta+beta*R(w,v/beta) for unit-L1 vectors; verified in both directions for beta0.1 and10.

strong_input_limit.meaning: As beta tends to infinity, only same-sign old populations preserve this isolated absolute difference.

interpretation: Cancellation can erase active contextual distinctions in reversed coordinates without erasing all cell-level context across the CC.
Same-sign injection can dilute relative composition while leaving an absolute difference unchanged in this additive, unsaturated operation.
Actual context-dependent input selection, nonlinear dynamics and recurrence can change the result; per-pair factors must not be multiplied to claim sequence memory.
No separate history field, population index pairing, new encoder, retention threshold or learning rule is selected.

raw_input_context_retention.status: conditional same-scale embedding arithmetic; not a selected encoder or learned memory result

source.access: Read-only mmap of existing local SSD tensor; no copy, download or modification.

sampling.limits: Same type sample and unordered pairs, evaluated in both directions. No corpus transitions, semantic labels or iid-pair claim.

raw_input_context_retention.assumptions: Same zero-sum within-population history differences as fixed_input_context_retention. Add a new raw embedding at the same global scale as the old embedding, followed only by H77. Row-normalized vectors are used internally only to calculate relative differences; norm ratio restores the raw input strength. No recurrence, clipping, input selection, noise or readiness operations.
raw_input_context_retention.formula: R_raw(v,w) = sum_same |v_j|/||v||_1 + sum_opposite max(|v_j|-|w_j|,0)/||v||_1. With q=||w||_1/||v||_1, R_raw(v,w)-q*R_raw(w,v)=1-q.
interpretation: A similar median under row normalization can conceal materially different per-token input strength and tails.
Raw tensor amplitude, diagnostic normalization and actual encoded activation are different; common scaling is another conditional comparison, not a chosen runtime input rule.
The measured retention concerns one specified cell-rate difference family, not learned context accuracy or a sequence lifetime.

lexical_contrast_probe.status: Read-only lexical input-row measurements and conditional net-sum arithmetic

selection.boundary: Small hand-chosen English lexical contrasts, not a representative valence dataset or a definition of complementary DMN states. All declared pairs retained.

source.access: 22 selected local SSD rows read only; no full tensor scan or copy

lexical_contrast_probe.token_identification: Exact leading-space vocabulary entries; merge-rank replay on the declared ASCII word chunks returns each one as a single token. No full tokenizer library or surrounding-text behavior is claimed.
lexical_contrast_probe.conditional_law: Before other transfer, clipping, noise or recurrence, H77 preserves coordinate net n+g*p. With unit-L1 rows, f(g)=sum(abs(n_i+g*p_i)); f is convex and f(0)=1. Its right derivative at0 equals1-2*sum(abs(p_i) for n_i*p_i<0), including zero n correctly. A nonnegative derivative implies f(g)>=f(0) for every g>=0.
lexical_contrast_probe.units: Unsigned aggregate signed-coordinate rate under the stated linear readout, not neuron active fraction or a semantic-valence score. Unit-L1 scaling is diagnostic only; raw-row results retained separately.
limits: A learned DMN state is not necessarily one of these negative-labeled rows.
Lexical labels are illustrative; contextual meanings, polysemy and compositional inputs are not measured.
No claim that a residual has positive meaning, that active-cell fraction rises/falls, or that the complete recurrent model fails/succeeds.
No embedding rotation, centering, sign flip, learned valence map, remapping or new classifier selected.

matched_envelope_relaxation_reference.purpose: Distinguish temporal-frame publication from self-retention dynamics, and semantic fading from contextual composition retention, without choosing a leak or extra state.

provenance.method: Exact Fraction matrix-vector identities for four parameter cases; closed-form mode powers, no neural trajectory or trained model.

assumptions: Four nonnegative cells: a1,a2 share one positive semantic population and b1,b2 share another. Other cells, including negative populations, contribute zero in this restricted reference.
P exchanges a1 with b1 and a2 with b2; these are cross-minicolumn connections, not paired opposing cells or proposed internal minicolumn edges.
T=(1-beta)*I+beta*g*P, with no external drive, noise, threshold, learning or rounding. H77 acts as the identity because no opposite activity is present.

Two earlier histories leave x=(1,0,0,1) and y=(0,1,1,0), each with the same semantic sum one in each of the two populations. No requirement that the input encoder directly produces these particular contextual patterns.

derivation.semantic_mode: For both histories each population sum is multiplied by q=1-beta+beta*g.
derivation.context_mode: x-y=(1,-1,-1,1) is an eigenvector with mu=1-beta-beta*g. Its k-step difference is mu^k*(x-y), while each population sum is q^k.
derivation.matched_envelope: Choose illustrative q=63/64 and g=1-(1-q)/beta. Each case has the same total and per-coordinate fading, with half-life log(1/2)/log(q) frames.
derivation.normalized_composition_difference: Relative contrast changes by mu/q per transition; absolute contrast and contrast relative to the surviving semantic sum differ.

interpretation: beta=1 alternates contextual patterns while preserving their contrast relative to the fading amplitude. beta=1/2 reduces relative contrast by 1/63 each step at the same semantic envelope.

beta=65/128 and g=63/65 merge the two complete four-cell states after one transition. Under fixed learned graph and identical future input/noise law, this restricted model cannot recover which earlier state occurred.
The pair comparison identifies a possible information loss, not useful task memory: preserved differences still need to improve later context-sensitive prediction.
State mixing is a modeling choice even when implemented through the same two frames. Matching a dominant-response half-life does not establish equivalent contextual retention.
non_adoptions: No leak, time step, integration law, reciprocal circuit, per-neuron constant, context field or diagnostic runtime array selected.
No statement that direct updates are better than relaxation, or that the example predicts SNN performance.
No spontaneous small loops are rejected; no morphology or physical-distance bias introduced.

bounded_composition_reference.purpose: Distinguish geometric composition freedom, finite representable patterns and learned reliable context.
assumptions: One surviving polarity with60 cells, fixed total A, each rate in[0,R], R>0. This is a conditional cap, not an application choice.
The discrete count uses uniform unsigned codes0..Q with rate R*code/Q, Q=15 or255. It is not FP4, a signed INT format, or a selected neuron representation.
Counts include every syntactically representable pattern at the exact total; no trajectory, reachable-state model or decoder is supplied.

derivation.continuous: For0<A<60R the bounded fixed-total slice has affine dimension59, but its L1 diameter is2*min(A,60R-A). At A=0 or60R it is a singleton.
derivation.diameter_bound: For two nonnegative vectors of equal sum A, L1 distance is at most2A. Applying the same bound to their deficits R-r gives2*(60R-A). For even60, disjoint filled supports attain2A up to A=30R; complementary deficits attain the other half.
derivation.count: The number at code total S is the coefficient of x^S in(1+x+...+x^Q)^60. Symmetry follows by replacing each code j with Q-j.
derivation.meaning: log2(count) is only a combinatorial storage upper bound at that exact total. It is not robust memory capacity, independent contexts, training success or a rate-format recommendation.

verification.large_checks: Exact coefficient symmetry, total cardinality, endpoint counts and stars-and-bars until the cap binds, for both bit widths.

interpretation: At total59R, continuous diameter is2R even though the local interior dimension is59. At total60R no active composition distinction remains in this coordinate.
One code step above zero or below full saturation has only60 patterns at the exact total, irrespective of whether storage has4 or8 bits; the physical step differs.
H77 can leave other coordinates informative; predictive semantics remain open. A cap or loss of one coordinate does not establish whole-network history loss.
bounded_composition_reference.non_adoptions: No cap, saturation law, normalization, coding objective, entropy estimator, extra context state or preferred numeric format.

rated_valence_geometry.conditional_arithmetic: With an input p and prior n represented by linear signed coordinate totals, H77 gives net n+g*p before other transfer/noise/recurrence. f(g)=L1(n+g*p) is convex. For unit-L1 p, f right derivative at0 is1-2 times input mass opposing n; zeros contribute positively. Nonnegative derivative makes f nondecreasing for all g>=0.

balanced_drive_frame_scaling.kind: Closed-form composition arithmetic; no time-marching neural simulation
balanced_drive_frame_scaling.value_lineage: C26/P60 useful contextual distinctions, C24/P52 temporal semantics, H70/H71/H74 and H77; compare frame/noise units without new runtime state.
assumptions: Two histories begin with different positive-cell compositions and the same positive active total A>0; their negative active populations are zero.

Each operation adds identical realized positive-cell drive to both histories and equal aggregate drive to the opposing polarity, then applies H77 without another transfer, clipping, recurrence, feedback or rounding.
Added drive totals Z_delta=kappa*Delta^alpha in each polarity; kappa has activity/time^alpha units. Model horizon T contains an integer T/Delta operations.

Reference allocation is uniform within each polarity; equal realized drive between histories is what supplies the contraction identity. This deterministic balanced input is not a sampled white-noise model.

derivation.one_operation: A remains the signed total; q_next=(A*q+z)/(A+Z_delta). Two histories therefore differ by A/(A+Z_delta) times their preceding composition difference.
derivation.log_asymptotic: log(R_Delta)=-(T*kappa/A)*Delta^(alpha-1)*(1+O(Delta^alpha)) for alpha>0 as Delta tends to zero through frame divisions of T.

balanced_drive_frame_scaling.reference_units: A=1 activity unit, T=1 model-time unit, and kappa=1 in the appropriate activity/time^alpha units; alpha1 and1/2 match at the one-unit reference interval. These are alternative drive calibrations, not the same fully specified physical noise law.
balanced_drive_frame_scaling.assessment: Preserving the signed total does not make contextual retention independent of cadence. Scaling a positive balanced contribution by sqrt(Delta) differs from preserving its per-time mean; this reference does not establish the statistics of independently sampled noise after nonlinear cancellation.
limits: R_Delta is the ratio of two composition differences under the stated operations, not a learned-memory lifetime or a success score.
Actual noise can have unequal totals, polarity reversals, correlations, recurrent amplification and activity-dependent control. No universal noise/step prescription follows.
The comparison uses existing rate values and H77; no context array, adaptive noise mechanism, scheduler or additional state is selected.
